Replace with one reliable preference about me.

Prepare a MeBot context JSON file using only preferences I have explicitly shared with you. Do not assume you can read another assistant’s memory or my private accounts. Do not invent interests, location, identity or goals. Omit passwords, tokens, financial details, health details and private client information. Return valid JSON only, not Markdown. Use this exact schema example: %1$s. Replace the sample entry with concise preferences you actually know; give each a unique ID, category interest, preference or goal, confirmed true, origin imported, updatedAtMillis 0, and only relevant module scopes from: %2$s. Leave name, region and timezone blank when unknown. Keep modules as an empty array so my existing module choices remain. If nothing is known, return entries as an empty array. OpenAI account access guide
How do I set up MeBot?

1. Connect a ChatGPT account or API key in You → AI connection.
2. Add your preferences in You → My context. Use the prompt below in ChatGPT, then import or paste the JSON.
3. Open Modules, enable what interests you, and adjust each module.
4. Refresh Feed. Open a post for an explanation or use Search.
Does connecting ChatGPT import my memory?

No. Sign-in provides account identity and, when allowed, model access. It does not give MeBot your ChatGPT chats or saved memories. Prepare a context file inside ChatGPT, review it, and import it here. An API key also does not include ChatGPT memory.
ChatGPT account or API key: which should I use?

Choose the route you want MeBot to use. ChatGPT uses the models and allowance available to your connected account. An API key uses that API account’s separate usage and billing. Run the connection check after choosing a model. MeBot does not silently switch billing routes.
How do modules and recommendations work?

Browse all modules or filter enabled and disabled ones. Each has a default brief; add topics, preferences and approved notes for closer matches. Drag modules to change filter order. Context sharing is chosen per module. Horoscope needs a selected sign and is optional entertainment.
What happens when I open a post?

When connected, MeBot starts a sourced AI explanation automatically. Ask a follow-up on the same page. A recent completed explanation can reopen from cache without a new request. If generation fails, retry; incomplete answers are not saved as finished explanations.
Can I search across my modules?

Use Search on Feed and enter a topic or question. Search all enabled information modules or choose one. Results include sources and can be saved or opened for an explanation. Weather and horoscope use their own configured flows.
Can MeBot always read the whole article?

Some publishers restrict full text. MeBot can explain accessible information and find related sources, but it cannot guarantee access to every article or paywall. Check linked sources for important claims. AI answers can still contain mistakes.
What does Unlimited mean?

Unlimited removes MeBot’s own daily AI-request cap. Your provider’s plan limits, credits, rate limits and billing still apply. The starting choice is 28 requests; you can select a preset or enter a custom amount in Background updates. Cached reading does not use another request.
Why did a background update or alert arrive late?

Android schedules background work around network and battery conditions, so the interval is approximate. Check notification permission, your refresh interval, quiet hours and module alerts. A provider limit can pause AI updates while cached content remains available.
What works without internet or AI?

Previously loaded stories, saved items, context and completed conversations remain on this device. Local alarms, focus and daily tools do not need an AI connection. New information, new AI answers and opening external sources need network access.
What personal information is sent to AI?

MeBot sends the information needed for the request, including confirmed notes assigned to the selected module and relevant conversation content. Review each note’s module choices in My context. Attachments are sent only in the conversation where you add them. Keep passwords and confidential third-party data out of context files.
Will importing context replace my saved items?

A context import replaces your profile and context notes after review. With modules:[] it keeps your module choices, saved reading and connection. A full feed backup is different: review its replacement summary first and reconnect AI afterward. Export a backup from You → Data and backups before moving to another phone.
Why are voice controls missing?

Voice input and read-aloud use compatible Android speech services on your phone. Their availability and supported languages depend on those services. You can always type questions and read the response.
How do I make sure my alarm rings?

Open Sound & snooze in an alarm. Choose Pulse, Rising chime, Steady bell or Classic, or select a phone sound or audio file. Preview uses the current alarm volume. An optional spoken message needs an installed offline voice; without it, the tone keeps ringing. Unavailable audio falls back to Pulse, including before the first unlock after restarting. Check the required permissions and volume, then test a short alarm with the phone locked.
